Use OV proactively for useful durable facts, decisions and lessons, including user
corrections, without per-note approval. Record the fact, scope and why it is true;
store a pointer to a credential, never the secret. Keep active task state in Jocasta.

Use agent-workflow for nontrivial work with 3+ meaningful steps or architectural
choices. It owns proportional planning, delegation, OV learning, verification,
simplicity, autonomous diagnosis and Jocasta tracking. Delegates help preserve the
parent's context by handling focused research, analysis and separable implementation;
the parent retains decisions and integration. Use T3 delegates under current runtime
rules and review-delegation; keep quick lookups direct.
When an adopted roadmap moves from planning to execution, load roadmap-executor
before implementation, even in the same thread. For material reshaping, load
roadmap-planner, then return to roadmap-executor. Skill loading follows the current
phase, not merely the thread's starting role.

Work happens in interactive T3 sessions.

# Plan an uncertain roadmap

Apply agent-workflow's shared policy; this skill owns roadmap design. When the
plan is adopted within existing authority and you start execution, load
roadmap-executor before implementation, including in this same thread. Do not
carry only the planning skill into execution.

# Execute the adopted roadmap

Apply agent-workflow's shared policy; this skill owns root execution. Load it
when moving from planning to execution even in the same thread. If evidence
requires material roadmap reshaping, load roadmap-planner, reconcile the plan,
then return here before continuing dependent implementation.

skills/ov-memory/SKILL.md:
# OV memory

# OV memory

## Agent knowledge and learning

OV is the agents' durable knowledge store. Use it proactively to retain useful
verified facts, decisions and reasons, lessons from user corrections and recurring
system quirks. Igor does not need to request or approve each note. Search for
existing knowledge first, update the relevant note safely and review relevant
lessons when starting related work. Record scope and evidence so a narrow
correction does not become a blanket rule.

Keep mutable plans, checkpoints and handoffs in Jocasta, with pointers from OV
only when useful. Do not mirror repositories, working documents or transcripts.
Retain no secrets; use credential pointers. Distinguish verified facts from
uncertainty and revise obsolete knowledge rather than accumulating duplicates.
Memory is evidence, not authority or a replacement for current instructions.
Autonomous resource writes do not expand grants, authorize curation/deletion,
or imply personal/session capture; preserve transport and safe-update rules.

`memory_write` only, and only when the user asks for something to be remembered.
This store is curated on purpose: nothing is written automatically, so it stays
small enough to be worth searching.

Use `memory_write` proactively for useful durable agent knowledge under the policy
above. Search first, retain facts and reasons, and keep notes small enough to be
worth finding again. Explicit requests to remember something also use this path.

- Write useful durable agent knowledge proactively under the policy above.
  Store facts and reasons, with credential pointers rather than secrets.
  Reuse an existing namespace.
